sources.title: GitHub - Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
sources.snippet: Start from the official MiniMax-H3 workflow (t2v or i2v) and make two changes: Insert MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA between the model loader and the sampler (… → Load Diffusion Model → MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA → SamplerCustomAdvanced), and pick the turbo .safetensors. Feed SamplerCustomAdvanced from MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler, and set the scheduler node (BasicScheduler) to simple at ≥ 4 steps ...

sources.title: MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA - Models
sources.snippet: insert MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA between the model loader and the sampler; replace the sampler feeding SamplerCustomAdvanced with MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler (4-step), and set the scheduler to 4 steps (simple). Everything else stays as in the official workflow, so both t2v and i2v work.
